title: Handoff verify report
description: Structured output of kaizen-handoff verify — mechanical checks against the current tree plus a list of qualitative items the agent must look at directly. Verdict rolls up from finding severities per verify-rules.yaml::verdict_rollup.

verdict.description: Top-level rollup: clean = no findings, drift = warn-level findings, regression = red-level findings (e.g. failed-pattern reintroduced).

handoff_file.description: Absolute path of the handoff YAML that was verified.

handoff_date.description: Date from the handoff's frontmatter (YYYY-MM-DD). Drives git --since filters.

file_checks.description: One entry per file in done_this_session.files (deduplicated).

pattern_checks.description: One entry per worked/failed list item — git grep results.

since.description: ISO date used for the --since filter.

qualitative_residue.description: Items the verifier cannot check mechanically — for agent attention.

recent_tool_churn.description: BK-010: when --dxm-session is set, surfaces last-60s per-tool counts from dxm. Empty object when dxm is empty or unavailable.

parse_error.description: Set when _parse_handoff_yaml failed to load the YAML body. Forces verdict=regression — the YAML itself is malformed, so file/pattern checks ran on an empty body and cannot be trusted.

freshness.description: BK-021. Staleness signal — how old this handoff is + how many commits have landed since. Rolls into the top-level verdict alongside file/pattern checks.

modified_since.description: If status=modified, the timestamp of the most recent commit touching this path since the handoff date.
